gloss: to glitter; to sparkle; to twinkle

definitions.gloss: to glitter; to sparkle; to twinkle; to glisten
definitions.explanation: To shine with a bright, flickering light; to give off flashes of light.

examples.japanese: {宝石|ほうせき}が{光|ひかり}にきらめいた。
examples.english: The jewel sparkled in the light.

examples.japanese: {夜景|やけい}にきらめく{街|まち}の{灯|あか}りが{美|うつく}しかった。
examples.english: The city lights glittering in the night view were beautiful.

notes:
VERB TYPE:
{自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive verb)
Godan verb ({五段動詞|ごだんどうし})

KANJI:
Can be written as {煌|きら}めく (literary).

CONJUGATION:
・きらめかない (negative)
・きらめいて (te-form)
・きらめいた (past)

ONOMATOPOEIA:
Related to きらきら (glittering, twinkling), which is the onomatopoeic adverb form.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{輝|かがや}く - to shine, radiate (broader meaning)
・{光|ひか}る - to shine, glow
・またたく - to twinkle (especially stars)
・きらきら{光|ひか}る - to glitter
